component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Content rows: 0 "empty0" (no items), 1 "row1" (3 items), 2 "empty2" (no items), 3 "row3" (2 items), 4 "row4" ' (3 items). Items are titled with their CONTENT row index (R1C0 is child 0 of content row 1). sub init() m.seq = 0 counts = [0, 3, 0, 2, 3] titles = ["empty0", "row1", "empty2", "row3", "row4"] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") row.title = titles[r] for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "R" + r.toStr() + "C" + c.toStr() end for end for m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.rows.content = root m.rows.observeField("rowItemFocused", "onFocused") m.rows.setFocus(true) m.steps = [ { op: "mark", phase: "rest" }, { op: "shot", name: "rest" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "mark", phase: "down1" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "mark", phase: "down2" }, { op: "shot", name: "down2" }, { op: "jump", to: [3, 1] }, { op: "mark", phase: "jump31" }, { op: "jump", to: [1, 1] }, { op: "mark", phase: "jump11" }, { op: "done" } ] m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") m.timer.duration = 2 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, kase as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = m.seq.toStr() while len(s) < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + kase + "|" + body end sub
function pair(v as object) as string if v = invalid or v.count() < 2 then return "[]" return "[" + v[0].toStr() + "," + v[1].toStr() + "]" end function
sub onFocused() rec("event", "rowItemFocused", "value=" + pair(m.rows.rowItemFocused)) end sub
sub runSteps() while m.steps.count() > 0 s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "mark" rec(s.phase, "state", "rowItemFocused=" + pair(m.rows.rowItemFocused)) else if s.op = "jump" rec("jump", "to", "value=" + pair(s.to)) m.rows.jumpToRowItem = s.to else if s.op = "shot" rec("await", "shot", "name=" + s.name) m.timer.duration = 4 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key, "rowItemFocused=" + pair(m.rows.rowItemFocused)) m.timer.duration = 2 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end", "rowItemFocused=" + pair(m.rows.rowItemFocused)) m.top.probeExit = true return end if end while end sub
